requirement.description: The _check_process method in Simulator class has flawed logic for detecting testbench functions. It fails to properly distinguish between generator functions and testbench functions that expect a Context parameter, causing TypeError when testbench functions are called with an unexpected argument.
requirement.contract: The _check_process method should correctly identify testbench functions (functions with 'ctx' parameter) and route them appropriately to add_testbench rather than add_process.

requirement.description: The Context class method 'tick' returns a Tick object but doesn't properly handle domain validation. This leads to incorrect domain handling in test cases.
requirement.contract: The Context.tick() method should properly validate domain names and return a Tick object with correct domain validation.

requirement.description: The Context class defines a duplicate method named 'delay' which shadows the Delay class constructor. This causes a TypeError when trying to create Delay objects because the method overrides the class.
requirement.contract: The Context class should not override the Delay class constructor with a method named 'delay'. The Delay class constructor should remain accessible.

requirement.description: The Context class method 'sample' doesn't properly handle signal sampling. It raises AttributeError when trying to access signal properties that don't exist.
requirement.contract: The Context.sample() method should properly sample signal values without raising AttributeError.

requirement.description: The PriorityEncoder class has incorrect logic for determining when no bits are asserted. It should return 0 when no input bits are asserted, not 1.
requirement.contract: The PriorityEncoder.n signal should be 0 when any input bit is asserted, and 1 when no input bits are asserted. The output should be 0 when no bits are asserted.
